newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin confirms pension fund talks.
newsitem.headline: Serfin confirms pension fund talks.

text.p: A Grupo Financiero Serfin source on Wednesday confirmed that talks were in a "very advanced" stage with Citibank and Chilean pension fund manager Habitat SA to set up a fund administrator (Afore).
Habitat vice president Ricardo Zabala said in Santiago on Wednesday that the deal could be done in the next few weeks.

He said Serfin would own 51 percent of the Afore with the rest held by a Chilean company set up this year between Habitat and Citibank. The firms will invest between $80 million and $100 million, he said.
The Serfin source declined to comment on Zabala's comments.
Serfin recently called off a pension fund partnership with Banco Santander, after Santander announced it was seeking to buy a large stake in another Mexican bank.
